{{Quote|The leader of the Mandalorians is Monta Drai. They work for the Empire, but Monta has a slave trade operating on the side.|[[Alya Selray]]|<ref name="TOR:TMT" />}}
'''Monta Drai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He and a group of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were hired by the Empire to capture many [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] villagers and turning them into slaves. He encountered a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacer who was sent by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Alya Selray]] to rescue the villagers and end the threat once and for all. Monta and his men engaged the individual, but were all defeated.<ref name="TOR:TMT" />
